decisions.scope: standard plan: all four axes measured, 3 repeats (1 for N >= 2,000), plus the optional component breakdown (section 7.4)
decisions.budget: 15,030,750 items in the sweep; at the observed ~260-290 items/s about 16 h of `ssat run` plus about 4 h of metrics/analyze/report/estimate, i.e. about 20 h (the plan's ~10 h underestimates the item total; deviations.md D-008)

reference_workload.fixed: global_seed 20260820, dataset_stats.channel_mean, adapter (max_batch_size 128), runtime (num_workers 12, variants_per_chunk 128, target_batch_size 128, retry_failed), dump settings; no --minimum-accuracy
reference_workload.varied: source.annotation_file (subset), regions (one grid family grid_<g>x<g>), perturbations (V level), controls (K level; [] for K=0)

subset.rule: the N files with the lowest sha256('rev1-a4:' + filename) (common/subsets.py top_n_subset, salt 'rev1-a4'); nested across N
subset.note: N=50 is the warm-up, N=200 the component profile

levels_v.7: + constant_fill value 0.0, + patch_shuffle patch_size 4 (synthetic study FILL_PARAMS)

execution.order: profile_components.py first, then run_scaling.py all --repeats 3 (axes samples, regions, controls, perturbations); nothing else runs on the host meanwhile
execution.repeats: 3 for settings with N < 2,000, 1 otherwise; within an axis the level order is rotated by one position per repeat (round-robin); shared settings are measured only in the first axis listing them
execution.warm_up: before each axis one N=50 center-setting run through all four phases, recorded in warmups.jsonl and excluded
execution.phases: ssat run --yes, metrics, analyze, report; each in an isolated wrapper process (run_benchmark.measure_step) giving wall time and peak RSS
execution.run_split: ssat --log-file: audit loop = runtime.started -> runtime.finished (1 s resolution); preflight = run wall time minus loop
execution.gpu: nvidia-smi memory.used and utilization.gpu every 0.2 s during run (own poller; D-008)
execution.storage: bytes per subdirectory (clean, perturbed, index, metrics, analysis, report, other) after run and after report; dumps are deleted after measurement
execution.estimate: ssat estimate --json once per setting (predicted remaining seconds, profile items/s)

stages: (b) iter_prepared_work_chunks with num_workers 12 (all chunks) and 0 (first 60 chunks), no inference
(c) per prepared chunk (first 150 chunks): adapter preprocessing transform_batch (CPU) and model forward incl. device transfer (GPU, synchronized), plus the main-process effective-area mask transform

analysis.fits: per axis and pooled: time_phase = a + b * items (OLS, R^2) for run, audit loop, preflight, metrics, analyze, report and peak RSS; bytes = c * items through the origin
analysis.throughput: items/s (clean + perturbed) of the audit loop and of the whole run against N
analysis.memory: peak RSS per phase vs items; the item count at which each phase would reach 125 GiB by linear extrapolation (labelled as extrapolation); GPU peak vs items
analysis.reference_points: 10,000-sample K=3 baseline (run_manifest started_at -> finished_at) and the A2 K=20 exact run (run_matrix_log elapsed), both measured differently from the sweep
analysis.coarse_to_fine: analytic items per sample: exhaustive 8x8 vs 2x2 followed by a 4x4 refinement of the top 2x2 cell (no extra runs)
analysis.estimate_accuracy: ssat estimate predicted seconds / measured run and loop seconds per setting
